notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
+noall +answer suppresses all dig output sections except the answer, producing minimal clean output. Equivalent to +short but preserves TTL and record type information. Useful for quick record lookup without the verbose header/footer.

=== vs +short ===
+short: bare answer value only (just the IP). +noall +answer: answer section only (includes TTL, record type, value). Choose based on whether TTL is needed.

=== SCRIPTING ===
Clean output is directly pipeable into grep/awk/cut. Used in automated loops where dig output needs parsing without stripping header lines.
